authentication_limits: These saved documents were obtained over official Debian HTTPS. Packages.xz hashes and lengths match their SHA256 entries in retained InRelease.
This metadata-retention task did not independently verify the InRelease OpenPGP signature; no gpg/gpgv was installed or trust bootstrap performed.

The actual runtime-security Docker stage uses normal APT3.0.4 update/download authentication with Debian keyring and no unauthenticated/trust override, followed by exact pinned DEB SHA256 and actual control/full-payload verification.
The SHA constants are derived from these exact package stanzas; pin provenance is not an age waiver, reproducible-source build or complete package security proof.
